run_async_coroutine_in_thread: run a coroutine in a new thread if the current thread is already running asyncio
merge_async_iterators_in_parallel: merge multiple async iterators into a single async iterator and process them in parallel
convert_async_iterator_to_sync: convert an async iterator into a synchronous iterator using a background thread and queue
convert_sync_iterator_to_async: convert a synchronous iterator into an async iterator so it does not block the main thread
decorate_blocking_function_for_thread: decorate a blocking function to execute it in a thread and return a coroutine
